description: A tree of floodplain (varzea), terra firme, 24-30 m tall. Not described by a source read. Called a canopy species ('especie de dosel') with high importance value in two Los Amigos floodplain plots. Fruit: yellow with white dots (Los Amigos specimen, fruiting 21 Aug 2002).

range.where: Los Amigos / Madre de Dios, SE Peru (sources read); Berg 1972: widespread from Mexico southward, not equally common throughout

notes: Template parashorea_malaanonan: a canopy tree: a clear bole and a broad crown (white seraya). NOT SOURCED (the template's or a default value): crown width (the template's ratio); crown depth (the template's); leaf size (the median of the research records' sourced simple leaves, 0.17 m); leaf colour (a tropical evergreen's mid green); bark colour (the template's); bark texture (the template's). Research notes: Poorly documented in open sources. Vela-Apaza 2024 (src 0): canopy species with high IVI in plots Bajio CM3 and Jacaratia (seasonally flooded floodplain, c. 23 days/yr, Madre de Dios). Atrium specimen Janovec & Maceda 2701 (src 1): 'Tree 30 m. Fruit yellow, with white dots. Latex white', upland terrace terra firme, 270 m; the height and fruiting month are this one tree. Berg 1972 Flora Neotropica 7 (src 2): genus latex white or yellowish; B. lactescens latex bitter (Ducke); staminate flowers may be complete; no species description of size, leaves or fruit on the page read. Search snippets mentioned Acre specimens 24-30 m, DBH 40-80 cm, whitish-grey bark and woolly monkey (Lagothrix cana) feeding at Manu Learning Centre, but those pages could not be read (NYBG verification wall; Field Museum PDF gone), so not entered. No common name found in sources read.
